debugData.name: Wetlands ruts' decal material
debugData.description: decalsGround_blend (the toolkit's ground decals, BLEND, wet: the ruts' puddle mask fills in the rain) tinted darker: the tyre tracks' own albedo barely shows on the pale rocks01 path (a decal's albedo replaces the ground's; docs/techniques/terrain-decals.md, A tint, not another atlas). The set's mud splatters share it. Its snow input (snow01) covers them as the ground's snow covers the path.
